actions.name: compress_file
actions.title: Compress files
actions.description: Compress multiple files into one file
actions.help: Use this action to compress multiple files into one file. Compressed file contents will be returned using the chosen compression format.

input.name: compression_format
input.label: Compression format
input.hint: Defaults to Zip if left blank.

input.name: archive_format
input.label: Archive format
input.hint: An archive format is required to combine multiple files into one archive file before compression.

input.name: password
input.label: Password
input.hint: Set a password if encryption is required.

input.name: unicode_names
input.label: Unicode encoding for filenames
input.hint: Set Yes if you are zipping non-english filenames and want to open them on Windows OS. Defaults to No if empty

properties.name: file_name
properties.label: File name
properties.hint: File name including extension. E.g. jan_report.csv

actions.name: convert_html_to_markdown
actions.title: Convert HTML to Markdown
actions.help: Convert HTML content to Markdown format. Dangerous tags and attributes are automatically stripped during conversion.

input.name: html_content
input.label: HTML content
input.hint: HTML content to convert to Markdown format

actions.name: read_file
actions.title: Get file from URL
actions.help: Get file contents from URL. Supports text and binary. Use streaming for files larger than 1024 MB .

input.name: url
input.label: URL
input.hint: Must be a publicly accessible URL

input.name: base64_encode
input.label: Base64 encoding
input.hint: Select Yes when the downstream action expects Base64 encoded value

input.name: include_line_breaks
input.label: Include line breaks?
input.hint: Select No to remove line breaks from the file content. Defaults to Yes if left blank.

input.name: is_large
input.label: Enable file streaming?
input.hint: Select Yes when the file you are trying to download has a file size larger than 200MB.

input.name: encoding
input.label: Encoding of the file content
input.hint: Specify the encoding of the file to set it explicitly. By default, encoding will be set to UTF-8 if left blank. Click here to know more about the different encodings supported.

actions.name: transform_image
actions.title: Transform image file
actions.help: Use this action to convert an image file to required type/size. Maximum file size is 50 MB . Action will fail if file is larger.

properties.name: pad_image
properties.label: Strict resize?
properties.hint: Resize maintains the aspect ratio and the resized image might be smaller than the specified size. To resize the image to exact measurement, set the flag to "Yes". When set to "Yes", Workato resizes th…

actions.name: uncompress_file
actions.title: Uncompress a file
actions.help: Uncompress a file and extract its contents. Supported file formats are .zip and .tar.gz . Maximum compressed file size allowed is 500 MB . Action will fail if the file is larger.

input.name: compression_format
input.label: Compression format
input.hint: Defaults to Zip if left blank.

input.name: password
input.label: Password
input.hint: Provide the password if archive is encrypted.

input.name: archive_format
input.label: Archive format
